step_by_step_approach: Identify each distinct user session in the activity log.
Within each session, locate the entry with the earliest timestamp to determine the landing page.
Within each session, locate the entry with the latest timestamp to determine the exit page.
For each page, gather the sessions where it appears as the landing page.
For each page, gather the sessions where it appears as the exit page.
Merge the landing and exit session lists for each page, removing duplicate sessions.
Count the unique sessions associated with each page.
Return each page together with its total count of unique sessions.
